[SWS_DM_00038] Continuing a frozen debounce timer
⌈
If a debounce
timer is frozen (i.e.
the corresponding monitor has called ReportMoni-
torAction() with kFreezeDebouncing (see [SWS_DM_00541])) and a new
kPrepassed or kPrefailed is reported for this event, the DM module shall continue
running the debounce timer starting with the frozen value.
⌋
